PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, APRIL 3, 2025
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Gina Maguire, President  Naomi Rainey, Commissioner
Kevin Scott, Vice President  Robert Shannon, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

 MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO SUBMIT EMAIL WRITTEN COMMENTS TO
  COMMISSION@LBUTILITIES.ORG

 CALL TO ORDER

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  25-54879  Recommendation to approve February 25, 2025 and March 20, 2025 Board
  meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  25-54880  Recommendation to approve Transfer of Funds for April 3, 2025.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  25-54881  Recommendation to receive and file the 2025 Annual Update from the Office of
  Ethics and Transparency.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 4.  25-54882  Recommendation to receive and file the Brown Act Training.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 5.  25-54883  Recommendation to adopt Specifications UD-25-248 and authorize the General
  Manager to execute a contract and any necessary subsequent amendments with
  Taylor Distribution Group, LLC, to furnish and deliver laboratory materials and
  supplies, in an amount not to exceed $282,000 for the initial one-year term. The
  contract includes the option to renew for up to two additional one-year periods, with
  each renewal period subject to a maximum annual increase of 10 percent over the
  prior year’s contract amount. The maximum potential contract amounts are
  $282,000 for year one, $310,200 for year two (if renewed), and $341,220 for year
  three (if renewed).

  Page 1 of 3
   PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, APRIL 3, 2025
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  25-54884  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to execute all documents
  necessary to amend the existing contract with Ocean Blue Environmental
  Services, Inc., to provide as-needed hazardous waste removal services to increase
  the total contract amount by $500,000, for a revised contract amount not to exceed
  $1,500,000.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  25-54885  Recommendation to receive and file Overview of Rancho Main Break Incident.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

8.  25-54886  Receive verbal presentation on Water Supply Update.

  Suggested Action:  Receive verbal report.

9.  25-54887  Recommendation to receive and file the March 2025 General Manager’s Monthly
  Report.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

10. 25-54888  Recommendation to discuss and refer potential agenda items to the Finance
  Committee.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Utilities Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Board.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Dynna Long, Executive Assistant to the Board, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72
hours prior to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans
with Disabilities Act, or if you need the agenda provided in an alternate format, please call the Board
of Public Utilities Commissioners Executive Assistant at (562) 570-2435 or (562) 570-6626
(telecommunications for the deaf) by 12 noon, the day prior to the meeting.

  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

NOTE:

If oral language interpretation for non-English speaking persons is desired or if a special
accommodation is desired pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, please make your request
by phone to the Office of the City Clerk at (562) 570-6101, 24 business hours prior to the Charter

7.  25-54885  Recommendation to receive and file Overview of Rancho Main Break Incident.

  Diana Tang, Assistant General Manager, Utilities Department, provided the staff
  report on the Bixby Hill water main break incident response and recovery efforts
  from February 7, 2025.

  Board members and the General Manager, Utilities Department, praised the
  leadership demonstrated by Diana Tang, Assistant General Manager, Utilities
  Department, and Tai Tseng, Assistant General Manager, Utilities Department,
  especially in handling the evolving nature of the incident and addressing community
  needs with sensitivity and awareness.

  A motion was made by Vice President Scott, seconded by Secretary Cordero,
  to approve recommendation. The motion carried by the following vote:

  Yes:  3  Cordero, Scott, Maguire
  No:  0  None
  Recused: 0  None
  Abstain: 0  None
  Absent: 2  Rainey, Shannon
